Dawes at Royale

with Shovels & Rope

  • Jun 20, 2013
  • Boston, Massachusetts

Dawes headlining the Royale on the Stories Don’t End tour — their third album, out that April. I latched on to their second, especially the track ‘A little bit of everything.’ Definitely teared up hearing it live. This show solidified me as a fan.
